scope_note: Independent verification of one official 2-iteration quick-test only. A bounded status retains all failed checks and accepts only independently recomputed final-sequence scores for the two affected CPC STE runs; no full experiment, baseline ranking, SOTA, dense-budget or functional claim.

upstream_cpc_ste_defect.explanation: CPC accepts beta but omits it in CodonPsiFunction.forward, whose default is beta=0. The runner nevertheless treats beta=1 accessibility_loss as the hard/discrete value. This can corrupt CPC-01/11 trajectory, initial and best metric fields without changing the independently recomputed final-sequence score.
